description: Attackers could gain unauthorized access to sensitive digital twin data through misconfigured IAM permissions or compromised credentials, potentially exposing industrial asset information and operational data.
Manipulation or corruption of digital twin data could lead to incorrect simulations, false analytics, and potentially dangerous physical system optimizations.
Single points of failure and lack of redundancy could lead to system-wide outages and loss of digital twin functionality.
Lack of comprehensive monitoring and anomaly detection could allow attacks or system issues to go unnoticed.
Attackers could exploit gaps between simulated and real-world behavior to cause operational disruptions or safety incidents.
